note: Town of Sand Creek park on the Red Cedar River, 3 miles north of Sand Creek, with a small-craft boat landing, walking trail and three pavilions; the river-row sites face the water through a band of trees. Mostly seasonal: about 26 of its 61 sites are sold by the night. --Claude
summary: Town park (Campspot listing shows a sole-proprietorship d/b/a, the county page names the Town of Sand Creek). 61 sites on the map, 26 daily (Campspot: 22 bookable daily sites incl. 4 30/50-amp up to 45 ft, 14 30-amp), 35 others not sold nightly -> ~43% nightly; Google 4.6 (88). $30 + fee, May 1-Oct 15. Riverview kept: the river row (D7, P8-P12, D13, P14) sits ~15-20 m from the river behind a band of trees; only D7/D13 are nightly and 13 is a 15-ft site. Pin within ~240 m of the campground (no move needed).
flags: LONG-STAY: nightly share ~43% (26 of 61; Campspot sells 22 daily sites). The map's 35 'P' sites are inferred to be seasonal from Campspot selling only 'Daily Use' categories and the 'Daily Use Camper Agreement'; no seasonal rate is posted. Five tests pass (posted $30 nightly rate, Campspot booking, nightly well over 10%, no lot sales). Google Maps 'Myran Park' 4.6 (88 reviews); Campspot 4.6 (25). Note now says it is mostly seasonal.

WATERFRONT: riverview kept. The Red Cedar here is ~55-65 m wide. The map's river row (D7, P8, P9, P10, P11, P12, D13, P14) lies along the bank near the boat landing at about 45.1925,-91.7055; on Esri z19 and NAIP the trailers there sit ~13-21 m from the water behind a continuous band of trees. Only D7 and D13 are sold nightly (site 13 is a 15-ft site on Campspot), so no on-water upgrade. Campspot tags the 30-amp category 'Riverside', but none of its sites carries the tag individually.

PIN: stored 45.1933,-91.7069 is on the open entrance ground west of the wooded loops, ~240 m from Google's point 45.1930,-91.7038 (Campspot 45.1937,-91.7038) - under 250 m, no move proposed (45.1932,-91.7045 would center the loops).
